parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry
reuses it) that makes a retried request safe. Required on every POST
(a PUT accepts it too); answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`
when absent and 400 `idempotency-key-invalid` when it is longer than
128 characters or not printable ASCII. A replay with the same key and
the same request (method, path and body) returns the stored response
with the header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a
different request is a 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. The stored
answer lives for 24 hours (ADR 0015): past that window the key is
free again — the same key and request executes anew (its effects run
again) and the same key with a different request is a new request,
not a 409. A refusal is
stored and replayed only when it is final for the request
(`invalid-*` validation, `case-already-resolved`, this key's own
400/409 problems; ADR 0015): a retryable refusal — 404
`case-not-found` (the case opens from a consumed fact that may not
have arrived yet) or 409 `concurrent-modification` (retry after
re-fetching the latest version) — is not stored; the key is
released, a retry under it executes again and a different request
under it is a new request.

parameters.name: X-Actor
parameters.description:
The operator identity the case's audit trail records for this
command (an operator id, e.g. `op-jane`). A label, not
authentication: the service has no auth layer (fleet decision
2026-09-11). Omitted (or blank) records `system`, the pre-header
behavior; a value with a NUL byte is 400 `invalid-actor`.

parameters.name: caseId
parameters.description: The case id (`case-` followed by a unique suffix, at most 64 characters).
